workload.note: The case exactly as executed; its sha256 matches the file committed at testcase commit f59074bc5, which identity.txt records beside it.

seed_and_generator_version.note: Fixed deterministic workload: four rows at three derived sizes with fixed byte patterns. No generator and no seed.

session_and_barrier_trace.note: The case is single-session, so there is no barrier to acknowledge between participants. What the journal does carry is the ordered external operation trace OOS-DUR-01 requires: a request line before each transaction and an acknowledgement line after it with the csql exit status, the affected-row count and the error count, plus the crash and restart steps, the recorded observations and the final case outcome.

injection_acknowledgements.note: No fault was armed: this is an unmodified-engine regression, and fault injection belongs to ticket 16's instrumentation worktree, not this one.

engine_identity.note: Pinned baseline commit, install prefix, the debug build's version string and the sha256 of libcubrid.so, libcubridsa.so, cub_server and csql, all re-verified against ticket 11 by run_attempt.sh before the launcher was allowed to start, plus the CTP jar and init.sh hashes.

testcase_identity.note: Repository, branch CBRD-26659-oos-testcases-handover, commit f59074bc5 and verified base commit e9c2d8687, appended after the case was committed together with the hash that shows the executed workload and the committed file are byte-identical.

specification_identity.note: Context revision f6543de with content hash c9daf3c4 and the catalogue hash 0cc33c82, the same pin ticket 11 and ticket 12 recorded.

build_and_configuration_identity.note: The exact CTP configuration used: scenario, no testcase update, no retry, and the campaign's own ports. The debug build and 16 KiB pages are fixed by the install named in identity.txt and by the case's own --db-page-size=16384, which assertion 2 reads back from spacedb; the durable-commit parameters are read back from paramdump by assertion 3. The pinned install's configuration as found is in install_conf_backup/.

instrumentation_identity.note: Unmodified engine. No patch, no instrumentation worktree, no fault-disabled control needed.

fixture_identity.note: Database t26659dur01, created by the case with --db-page-size=16384 --db-volume-size=64M --log-volume-size=64M. The fixture's generation inputs -- the three payload sizes and their byte patterns -- are constants at the top of workload.sh, derived by derive_case_sizes.py.

expected_versus_actual.note: The pre-derived oracle's ordered assertion list set against the result file the run produced, with the OK, NOK and SKIP tally. The case is its own comparator: every assertion names itself and prints expected and actual on failure, as the negative control shows.

logs.note: CTP runtime logs (feedback.log, test_local.log, test_status.data, test-shell.xml, dispatch lists), the PTY transcript, the case's own per-step outputs, and the debug $CUBRID/log/oos.log this build produced, which is the evidence for assertion 17.

cores.note: No core file. The crash is a kill -9, which produces none, and a search of the bundle and of the install found zero core files after the run.

replay_command_with_prerequisites.note: The replay command and the prerequisites it does not create: the pinned install and its library hashes, the CTP install, the testcase worktree at the recorded commit, the four free ports, and unprivileged user namespaces for the containment.

uncommitted_snapshots.what: OOS-CONTEXT.md at the pinned content hash, which was uncommitted in the context repository working copy when ticket 11 pinned it
